fact: The World Bank project record (approved 2016-09-27, US$5m, closed) describes expanding the existing IFMIS to additional ministries, departments and agencies and interfacing it with revenue and treasury systems.

The Accountant General's Department stated that IFMIS is operational, that Kanifing Municipal Council's IFMIS cashbooks and ledger were updated to August 2026, and that larger ministries, departments and agencies operate with it.

The GRA Commissioner General said the current domestic tax administration system is largely manual and that the new ITAS, ahead of rollout, is to replace it; the article carries no go-live date (as_of is the publication date).
system: current GRA domestic tax administration (largely manual)
